description: Kimi Code CLI hooks configured in ~/.kimi-code/config.toml (legacy: ~/.kimi/config.toml). Documented events: SessionStart, PreToolUse, Stop, SessionEnd. PostToolUse and UserPromptSubmit are candidates that stay inert if the CLI does not emit them. Source: https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code-cli/customization/hooks.html (checked 2026-10).
notes: No permission relay on purpose: Kimi Code has blocking PreToolUse hooks but no separate permission-request event, so prompting on every tool call would interrupt the user constantly.
